title: Merge K Sorted Lists
prompt: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
hints: Use a min-heap (priority queue). Push the head of each list. Pop the smallest, add to result, push its next.
Heap stores (val, listIndex) or the node itself. Compare by value.
Alternative: merge in pairs - merge list 0 with 1, 2 with 3, etc. Then repeat until one list. O(n log k).
Heap approach: O(n log k) where n = total nodes, k = number of lists.
